program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]

    for period in range(1, max(h, w) + 1):
        for diagonal in ("diff", "sum"):
            colors = {}
            consistent = True
            for r, c, color in points:
                index = (c - r if diagonal == "diff" else c + r) % period
                if index in colors and colors[index] != color:
                    consistent = False
                    break
                colors[index] = color
            if consistent:
                return [[colors[(c - r if diagonal == "diff" else c + r) % period]
                         for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
